name: learned_exact_target_agreement_v1
purpose: Measure frozen held-out evict_value_v1 agreement with exact H4 eviction-loss targets across the canonical 21 cells.
target_semantics: Finite-horizon H4 eviction-loss target with LRU continuation.
set_aware_agreement: learned-selected victim belongs to exact target-optimal set
lexicographic_agreement: learned-selected victim equals deterministic lexicographically first exact target-optimal victim
regret: learned selected target value minus minimum exact target value
